newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea intervenes to support won - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea intervenes to support won - dealers.

text.p: The central bank of Korea was observed stepping into the interbank market in Tuesday afternoon trading to slow the won's fall against the dollar, dealers said.
The intervention took place as the domestic unit fell to around the 852.70 level, they said.
The central bank denied intervening in the market, as it usually does.
Traders said the won is being pressured by the dollar's strength against the Japanese yen on world markets. In Tokyo, the dollar was steady near 117.80 yen in afternoon trading.
Shortly after the intervention, the won was trading at 852.20. It opened the day at 850.80
